effect_description_eng:
＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle, it checks security before the attack ends.)
＜Vortex＞ (At the end of your turn, this Digimon may attack an opponent's Digimon. With this effect, it can attack the turn it was played.)
[When Digivolving] Your opponent's Digimon effects don't affect 1 of your Digimon until their turn ends.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Counter] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your Digimon gets +3000 DP until your opponent's turn ends, then it may battle 1 of their Digimon.
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Angoramon] in text or w/[NSp] trait: Cost 3
